summary_md: **Oai Chu ([@oaichu95](https://x.com/oaichu95/status/2115841777475449216))** shares **flat-to-3d**, seven MIT three.js scroll demos that turn a flat architectural drawing into a walkable 3D house with no image files or 3D models (100–190 KB each), each with a starter prompt ([Sam1983Aing/flat-to-3d](https://github.com/Sam1983Aing/flat-to-3d)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - Sam1983Aing/flat-to-3d: Seven ways to turn a flat architectural drawing into 3D as you scroll. Live demos, full code and a starter prompt for each, all in three.js.

media.description: Card "Flat drawing > 3D house, as you scroll" listing seven demos: exploded house, section sweep, open section, build time-lapse, schedule build, card model, sunlit elevation.
